findings.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
findings.description: A cookie has been set without the HttpOnly flag, which permits the cookie to be accessed by client-side scripts.

findings.name: Cookie Without Secure Flag
findings.description: A cookie has been set without the Secure flag, which means it may be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections.

findings.name: Cookie without SameSite Attribute
findings.description: A cookie has been set without a SameSite attribute, which permits cross-site requests to send the cookie.

findings.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
findings.description: The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'.

findings.name: Re-examine Cache-control Directives
findings.description: The cache-control header algorithm detected weak or missing caching directives.

findings.name: Session Management Response Identified
findings.description: The request returned a response indicating session management features.
